originalTitle: 9 Nifty 500 stocks with up to 50% upside potential: Do you own any?
simplifiedContent: Here's what this news means: some experts who study the stock market think that 9 specific stocks have a good chance of going up in value over the next year. These stocks could increase in value by as much as 50%. The experts like certain companies, including Inox Wind, Aditya Birla Fashion, and HDFC Bank, and are telling people to buy them. This matters because if you own these stocks, you might see a big increase in their value, and if you're thinking of investing, these might be good choices. The experts are giving these stocks a "Strong Buy" or "Buy" rating, which means they think they're a good investment.

originalTitle: GMPs indicate 15 IPOs opening or listing this week could offer investors up to 37% returns
simplifiedContent: This week is expected to be busy for the stock market, with 15 new companies planning to either start selling shares or begin trading. These companies are divided into two groups: mainboard and SME (small to medium-sized enterprises) issues. Investors might be interested because some of these companies could bring in returns of up to 37% for those who buy their shares. This means that if you invest in one of these companies, you could potentially get back 37% more than you initially invested. The high number of companies listing or opening this week could provide opportunities for investors to make some money.

originalTitle: 14 penny stocks plunge up to 85% in 6 months. Are you holding any?
simplifiedContent: Some very cheap stocks, called "penny stocks", have lost a lot of their value - up to 85% - in just 6 months. This is because penny stocks are risky investments with low trading activity, which can cause their prices to fluctuate wildly. They can also be manipulated, meaning their prices can be artificially changed, and it can be hard to find reliable information about them. This makes them prone to sudden price drops, which is why they can be a bad investment. If you own any of these stocks, you might want to check how they're doing and consider what to do next.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: Some companies, including Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means people can buy their shares, hoping to make a profit later. These IPOs are set to start between August 10 and 12. At the same time, shares of eight other companies that recently had their IPOs will start trading on the market. This is important because it gives investors new options to put their money into, and could potentially affect the overall stock market.

originalTitle: Defence stock Apollo Micro Systems declares Q1 results 2026. Revenue jumps 88% YoY to  ₹251 crore, PAT up 43%
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defense industry, just released their financial results for the first quarter of 2026. Their revenue, which is the total amount of money they made from selling their products, increased by 88% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹251.3 crore. The company's net profit, which is the amount of money they have left after paying all their expenses, also increased by 43% to ₹25.2 crore. This is a significant increase and suggests that the company is doing well. This matters because it can affect the company's stock price and whether or not it's a good investment opportunity.

originalTitle: Q1 results 2026: Vodafone Idea to RVNL among companies to declare Q1 results next week; check full list here
simplifiedContent: Next week, several big companies like Vodafone Idea, Tata Motors, and Hindustan Aeronautics will announce their financial results for the first quarter of 2026. This means they will share how well they did financially from January to March 2026. These results are important because they can affect the companies' stock prices and influence investment decisions. A good result can make the stock price go up, while a bad result can make it go down. Investors can check the full list of companies announcing their results next week to stay updated on the market.
